name: Stilt Market
descriptorLine: A bazaar of rope bridges and tarp stalls over black water.
notableFeatures: Hanging lanterns, floating stalls, a ferry dock.
hooksSecrets: Contraband under the fish stalls; a hidden dive entrance under the tuna stall.

name: Flooded Platform
descriptorLine: A half-drowned train platform, ankle-deep and glowing.
notableFeatures: Cracked signs, a rusted train, tide marks on every wall.
hooksSecrets: Sunken tram line to the Drowned Cathedral.

name: Sail Garden
descriptorLine: Hydroponic terraces hung under repurposed sails.
notableFeatures: Rows of kelp and tomato under torn sails.
hooksSecrets: Seed vault in the old sail loft.

name: Seawall Control
descriptorLine: A concrete bunker bristling with tide gauges.
hooksSecrets: A forged order hides the Level 3 breach.

name: Drowned Cathedral
descriptorLine: A cathedral half-sunk into the sea, bells still ringing.
notableFeatures: Pews under water, a bell tower, a nave full of echoes.
hooksSecrets: The first tide-ledger rests in the vestry.

name: Tarp Town
descriptorLine: A sprawl of tarp shelters strung between pylons.
notableFeatures: Rope walkways, shared stoves, drying nets.
hooksSecrets: A rumored dry-room under the stoves.

name: Half-Sunk Lobby
descriptorLine: A flooded hotel lobby converted into a clinic.
hooksSecrets: Stockpile of antibiotics behind the old front desk.

name: The Rustyard
descriptorLine: A scrapyard of sunken ships and cranes.
hooksSecrets: A sealed wreck marked with Guild stamps.

name: Choir Shrine
descriptorLine: A hush-bound chamber humming with salt-crusted speakers.
notableFeatures: Speakers, salt idols, a central basin.
hooksSecrets: The basin connects to the Pale Listener.
